latin-america.text: The United States has lifted sanctions on Venezuelan National Assembly president Jorge Rodríguez, signaling a diplomatic thaw.
Costa Rica opened a Bukele‑model mega‑prison designed for 5,100 high‑risk inmates, sparking debate over incarceration policies.
RJ Mitte’s former girlfriend recalled him as her first love after his recent death, sharing heartfelt memories.

oceania.text: The Australia vs New Zealand men’s Rugby League World Cup match kicks off today, drawing huge crowds in Sydney.
Australian animator Lectrr releases today’s “Cartoon of the Day,” a satirical take on local politics.

middle-east.text: A BBC analyst says Yemeni forces are using aggressive tactics that confuse and neutralize Saudi air defenses.
A Chinese expert warns the US repeatedly challenges Iran, yet Tehran has never yielded.
Missiles were launched toward Saudi Arabia, striking near Najran and Jazan.
Colombia inaugurated its embassy in Jerusalem, marking a diplomatic shift.

asia.text: Two Singapore-flagged vessels were struck in the Hormuz Strait, one sinking after the attack.
Global oil prices slipped over 1% as weaker Chinese demand and rising U.S. inventories pressured the market.
Saudi Arabia issued a thunderstorm warning with heavy rain, raising concerns about potential flooding in low‑lying areas.

africa.text: Kenya's cabinet released Statement No. 31/2026 outlining new fiscal policies aimed at boosting infrastructure investment.
Raila Odinga's reform agenda stalls as President Ruto's ODM alliance reshapes power dynamics, risking unfinished projects.
Guinea's President Doumbouya granted pardons to several political detainees, signaling a potential easing of repression.
In Agboville, a fraudster posing as a Burkinabè diplomat swindled a hotelier out of 850,000 CFA francs.

north-america.text: Ilhan Omar’s phone was seized and relatives subpoenaed as part of a criminal investigation, officials said.
The Los Angeles Dodgers’ hopes for a three‑peat ended after a late‑season loss eliminated them from the playoffs.
A severe hailstorm battered Mexico City and the State of Mexico, causing widespread damage to roofs and vehicles.
A Canadian cybersecurity executive was arrested by the FBI amid a legal dispute with a former business partner, according to the Globe and Mail.
